lens: Geometry and proportion first, then colour, materials and artefacts. Candidate renders S/rH (q15-q18); baseline S/r0 = 1430d42 (the econ_final head). git diff 1430d42..8467f01 touches only 04_shaders.js, 07_shell.js, 12_scene.js and review files; 09a_econ.js and SEATMAT are byte-identical, so every r0 -> rH change is lighting. Median colours were measured with numpy in fixed boxes on r0, rH and the paired ANA photo resized to 930x575 (boxes drawn in S/raterB/*_box.jpg; stacks r0 / rH / photo in S/raterB/*_stack.jpg; script S/raterB/m.py). White plastic = pixels with mean > 150 and max-min < 45 below y 300 (whole frame for q18). Pixel diff r0 -> rH (summed |dRGB| > 24): q15 1.8 %, q16 2.7 %, q17 5.3 %, q18 0.4 % of the frame, all global tone; no outline moved. S = /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/71861e44-1883-57f3-a4ff-9d9ad060cbce/scratchpad.

issues.what: Carried w51b-1 / w51a-1: the 3-seat-block headrest flap is short and high and sits between the rolls; in y_47303 it drapes over the rolls' inner halves with its foot well down.
issues.evidence: Geometry byte-identical to 1430d42; q17_econBacks_stack.jpg shows the same outline as r0 and the prior measurements (97 x 78 px vs 79 x 100 px) stand.
issues.fix: Gated on question 32: drape blocks get a longer CPL (prepend [0.615,-0.150], [0.628,-0.151]) with hem, foot tube, stitch and mark moved to the new foot; roll sx +-0.163 -> +-0.128 and cushion w 0.30 -> 0.26 so the 0.21 flap overlaps the rolls (09a_econ.js; mirror in econUnitFar).

issues.what: The violet in the headrest covers is partly material: the yCover base #141b44 is short of green relative to the photos' slate, so both head-on and grazing covers read indigo-violet rather than slate / silver-grey.
issues.evidence: G-R and B/R, render rH vs photo: q17 off-axis flap G-R +7 vs +19 (B/R 1.37 vs 1.39); q15 head-on cover (44,48,86) B/R 1.95, G-R +4 vs y_47300 (40,45,73) 1.82, +5; q15 side-block cover (55,59,97) B/R 1.76, G-R +4 vs (64,70,98) 1.53, +6. Too much blue head-on, too little green off-axis in every view, independent of the lighting change (the lighting run moved them by <= 3 levels).
issues.fix: SEATMAT.yCover c '#141b44' -> '#131d3c' (R -1, G +2, B -8: lower B/R head-on to ~1.8, raise G-R). Keep r 0.52 + SHEEN; the remaining ~20 L grazing deficit belongs to the lighting sheen lobe.

notes: Confirm 2: econ geometry and materials are byte-identical to 1430d42, so the outline items keep their status (q15 cover fixed and holding; q17 3-seat flap length still the single medium econ item, gated on question 32). The 8467f01 lighting touch clearly fixed the L14 blue cast on whites (q17 armrest B-R +5, target <= 6; q15 whites +5) and brought the tick backs, pans and pillows to within ~0.1-0.2 B/R of the photos; the fleck backs are still slightly blue. The headrest-cover violet is not fixed; measurement shows its hue part is material (yCover short of green), its brightness part is the sheen lobe. Scores rise slightly on q15 / q17 / q18 for colour (8.8 / 8.45 / 8.65), q16 holds 8.3; overall 8.6 (mean 8.55). No regressions. High-severity econ issues: 0.
